description: This Java source file defines an enum JdbcJavaType that maps Java types to JDBC types for database interactions, including methods for type conversion, SQL formatting, and type support checks within the Fineract project.

classes.name: DialectType
classes.description: Immutable inner class representing JDBC type details, including name, precision, scale, and alternative names, used for SQL formatting and type mapping.

methods.name: getByTypeName
methods.description: Retrieves a JdbcJavaType based on the database dialect and type name, with optional error checking.

methods.name: getDialectType
methods.description: Returns the DialectType for a given database dialect, throws exception if not supported.

methods.name: isBooleanType
methods.description: Checks if the Java type is boolean.

methods.name: canBooleanType
methods.description: Determines if the type can be represented as boolean in the given dialect.

methods.name: isStringType
methods.description: Checks if the Java type is string.

methods.name: isVarcharType
methods.description: Checks if the type is VARCHAR or LONGVARCHAR.

methods.name: isTextType
methods.description: Checks if the type is a text or JSON type.

methods.name: isJsonType
methods.description: Checks if the type is JSON.

methods.name: isSerialType
methods.description: Checks if the type is a serial type.

methods.name: isIntegerType
methods.description: Checks if the Java type is integer.

methods.name: isAnyIntegerType
methods.description: Checks if the Java type is any integer type.

methods.name: isFloatType
methods.description: Checks if the Java type is float.

methods.name: isAnyFloatType
methods.description: Checks if the Java type is any float.

methods.name: isDecimalType
methods.description: Checks if the Java type is decimal.

methods.name: isNumericType
methods.description: Checks if the Java type is numeric.

methods.name: isDateType
methods.description: Checks if the Java type is date.

methods.name: isTimeType
methods.description: Checks if the Java type is time.

methods.name: isDateTimeType
methods.description: Checks if the Java type is datetime.

methods.name: isAnyDateType
methods.description: Checks if the Java type is any date type.

methods.name: isBlobType
methods.description: Checks if the type is a BLOB type.

methods.name: isBinaryType
methods.description: Checks if the Java type is binary.

methods.name: hasPrecision
methods.description: Checks if the dialect type supports precision.

methods.name: hasScale
methods.description: Checks if the dialect type supports scale.

methods.name: getJdbcName
methods.description: Returns the JDBC type name for the given dialect.

methods.name: formatSql
methods.description: Formats the SQL type string with optional precision and scale.

methods.name: toJdbcValue
methods.description: Converts a value to its JDBC representation, with optional type validation.
